title: Ujjayi
author: Lcporschen
changes: Trimmed to 1.94–4.90 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. The end of one slow breath in, the natural pause, then the start of the breath out; gentle 0.3 s / 0.4 s fades because a full slow breath cycle is longer than 3 s.
